name: reachinbox-scheduler
description: Production-grade email scheduler service + dashboard (BullMQ + Redis + Postgres + Next.js)

scripts.//prepare: Runs automatically after `npm install`. The API resolves @reachinbox/shared to its built dist, so a fresh clone needs this before anything will start.
scripts.prepare: npm run build -w @reachinbox/shared && npm run db:generate -w @reachinbox/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reachinbox/shared && npm run build -w @reachinbox/api && npm run build -w @reachinbox/web
